panel.summary: Undo no longer restores the caret to the edit site; the reverted text arrives as a remote transaction with only mapped selection
panel.evidence: The old path used @codemirror/commands' `undo`, which restores the selection recorded with the history event. The replacement (`historyKeymap`, editor.ts:209-238, "minus the selection-undo entries (Yorkie has no selection history)") routes to `store.undo()`, whose result comes back through `subscribeRemote` and is applied by `note-sync.applyRemote` as a plain `remote`-annotated transaction — CodeMirror only *maps* the existing selection through it. So undoing an edit made off-screen leaves the caret and viewport where they are, with no visible indication of what was reverted. `YorkieDocStore` solves exactly this by writing the pre-edit caret into Yorkie history via `recordHistoryPresence` with `{ addToHistory: true }` (yorkie-doc-store.ts:2683-2695); `YorkieNoteStore` has no equivalent. Searched: yorkie-note-store.ts (whole file), note-sync.ts applyRemote, editor.ts runHistory/historyKeymap, grep for addToHistory/recordHistoryPresence across packages/frontend/src.

This mirrors the existing undo-floor pattern, but keep the call in the undo-floor helper only so production undo capability continues to use the public `doc.history.canUndo()` contract.
